newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: New Congo's Kabila names two new ministers.
newsitem.headline: New Congo's Kabila names two new ministers.

text.p: Democratic Republic of the Congo President Laurent Kabila on Friday appointed two new ministers and one deputy minister to his government, state radio said.

Thomas Kanza was named Minister of International Cooperation and Etienne Mbaya was named Minister of Reconstruction and Urgent Public Works. Julianne Lumumba was appointed deputy minister of information.
Kanza is a well known political figure and a follower of Patrice Lumumba, the country's first prime minister after independence. The other two appointees are less well known.
When the first 13 members of the government were named two weeks ago, a spokesman said the final figure would be about 20.
Key posts were awarded to members of Kabila's Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo which last month ousted President Mobutu Sese Seko after a seven-month war.

The exclusion of veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi from the post of prime minister, which he claims on the basis of a 1992 national conference, provoked protests in the capital by his supporters.
